WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    (telescope_count * 100.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER ()) as share_pct
  FROM telescope_counts
),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    AVG(share_pct) OVER () as global_avg_share
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(share_pct) as avg_share,
  AVG(share_pct - global_avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM with_avg
WHERE share_pct > global_avg_share
